cells.name: S. cerevisiae
cells.note: Eukaryote. Crabtree positive: ferments to ethanol even with O2 when glucose is in excess.

reactions.name: Acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP)
reactions.equation: acald_c + h2o_c + nadp_c --> ac_c + 2 h_c + nadph_c

reactions.name: Acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD)
reactions.equation: acald_c + h2o_c + nad_c --> ac_c + 2 h_c + nadh_c

reactions.name: Acetyl-CoA synthetase (PDH bypass)
reactions.equation: ac_c + atp_c + coa_c --> accoa_c + amp_c + ppi_c

reactions.name: Pyruvate carboxylase
reactions.equation: atp_c + hco3_c + pyr_c --> adp_c + h_c + oaa_c + pi_c

reactions.name: Cytosolic citrate synthase (Cit2)
reactions.equation: accoa_c + h2o_c + oaa_c --> cit_c + coa_c + h_c

reactions.name: Malate synthase (Mls1)
reactions.equation: accoa_c + glx_c + h2o_c --> coa_c + h_c + mal__L_c

reactions.name: Glutamate dehydrogenase (NADP)
reactions.equation: glu__L_c + h2o_c + nadp_c <=> akg_c + h_c + nadph_c + nh4_c

reactions.name: Glutamina sintetasa
reactions.equation: atp_c + glu__L_c + nh4_c --> adp_c + gln__L_c + h_c + pi_c

reactions.name: Biomass (yeast core, with GAM)
reactions.equation: 1.24 3pg_c + 2.91 accoa_c + 52 atp_c + 0.32 e4p_c + 0.15 f6p_c + 0.13 g3p_c + 0.3 g6p_c + 0.25 gln__L_c + 4.2 glu__L_c + 52 h2o_c + 3.1 nad_c + 11.5 nadph_c + 1.5 oaa_c + 0.52 pep_c + 2.5 pyr_c + 0.9 r5p_c --> 52 adp_c + 3.6 akg_c + 2.91 coa_c + 52 h_c + 3.1 nadh_c + 11.5 nadp_c + 52 pi_c

reactions.name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase complex
reactions.equation: coa_m + nad_m + pyr_m --> accoa_m + co2_m + nadh_m

reactions.name: Citrate synthase
reactions.equation: accoa_m + h2o_m + oaa_m --> cit_m + coa_m + h_m

reactions.name: 2-Oxoglutarate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: akg_m + coa_m + nad_m --> co2_m + nadh_m + succoa_m

reactions.name: Succinyl-CoA synthetase
reactions.equation: atp_m + coa_m + succ_m <=> adp_m + pi_m + succoa_m

reactions.name: Internal NADH dehydrogenase Ndi1 (does not pump H+)
Mitochondrial ATP synthase
reactions.equation: adp_m + pi_m + 3 h_im --> atp_m + h2o_m + 2 h_m

reactions.name: bc1 + cytochrome c oxidase (pumps H+ into the intermembrane space)
